rules.description: IntelliJ + Keychron: Win + Tab and Option + Tab go to IntelliJ (Switcher)
Keychron (Windows mode): Command/Alt key = Command, Option/Win key = Option
Firefox: fn + F1-F12 media keys still work (MacBook keyboard)
fn (MacBook) / Control (Keychron) + Left/Right jumps a word, + Shift selects a word
Backspace closes: apps in Cmd + Tab switcher (all keyboards), tabs in Firefox Control + Tab view (MacBook keyboard)
Firefox: fn (MacBook) / Control (Keychron) works as Command
fn (MacBook) / Control (Keychron) + C copy, V paste, X cut, Z undo, A select all
Shift + Command switches input source (all keyboards)
Reset switcher state on key release
